signals.rationale: The man maintains steady eye contact and an upright posture while delivering his message. His voice is clear and steady, and he speaks fluently without any filler words or hesitation.

The man's speech is slightly broken up with filler words like 'uh' and 'I I', and his voice sounds tense as he describes the attack. He also blinks rapidly and his eyes dart nervously to the side at the end of the clip, indicating underlying anxiety.
